d:
The first 9 chapters of my webcomic Zoe the Vampire. If you like it please check out my site, I update with a new page every week and there is many more pages that aren't included here. I am in a slow process of redrawing all of these pages after getting a prequel chapter done, will take likely 2 years to redraw all this, just like this took 2 years to draw. So if you like it please come give the comic some love.
Zoe.yellowgerbilcomics.com

UPDATE
Added chapter 10. The artstyle changed about halfway through, someday I plan to go back and redraw all the chapters with better art, but too busy for that right now so is on the back burner. If you like the stuff please check out the comic on my site, Currently my site has a ton of more pages and a new page comes out every week.

UPDATE 2
Added Chapter Zero a prequel to help set things up a bit clearer.
